text:
alice: heads-up — ap-southeast GPU pool quiet-join failing; nodes stuck in JOINING for ~12m, affecting batch jobs
ben: seeing same in logs, KMS decrypt returned AccessDenied for node bootstrap identity
cheng: any recent KMS/IAM changes in ap-southeast?
alice: eng-security rolled a policy last night (audit-sampler v2) that tightened grant conditions to include `aws:SourceVpc`/`aws:SourceIp` for keystore decrypts
ben: but warmpool uses ephemeral privnet aliases, sourceVpc!=annotated value -> decrypt denied
marie: confirmed. sample from node bootstrap: ```error: decrypt failed: AccessDenied KMS:Decrypt on key alias/infra-keystore with condition aws:SourceVpc mismatch```
infra-bot: @eng-security audited-policy v2 deployed 2026-03-22T23:10Z to ap-southeast
cheng: okay — we have two options: (A) temporary grant exception for the warmpool role to bypass sourceVpc condition, (B) rollback sampler v2 in ap-southeast, (C) route joins through a nat/egress that matches tagged VPC — tradeoffs?
alice: immediate priority is unblocking joins. pref to avoid full rollback. option A seems fastest if eng-security approves
marie: note cost impact: if we keep warmpool disabled and fall back to on-demand GPU starts, estimate +$8k/day for peak workloads
ben: also risk: temporary grant widens attack surface if not scoped; need tight TTL and audit markers
cheng: propose temporary grant with these constraints: `Condition: StringEquals: { "aws:RequestTag/rls_temp": "gpu-join-20260323" }`, TTL 2 hours, and explicit audit log entry. revert script ready.
alice: pinging @eng-security for emergency exception, will also trigger a canary after 5 joins
marie: +1 on canary. also add traffic capture for first 10 joins to verify no unexpected egress
infra-bot: created incident stub: INC-20260323-ml-join-blocker, assigned to eng-ml and eng-security
ben: if eng-security agrees, I can apply the grant in 3m and run canary
cheng: after grant applied, we should run `kubectl -n ml get nodes --selector=pool=ap-southeast-warm` and `journalctl -u bootstrap -f` to watch decrypt step
alice: eng-security (cc @marie) — do we have approval for timeboxed grant with tag constraint + 2h TTL?
marie: approving emergency exception with those exact tag TTL constraints. eng-ml please paste the grant statement and set automated revert. I'll monitor audit logs.
ben: applying now. grant snippet:
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast:123456:key/infra-keystore",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/rls_temp": "gpu-join-20260323"}}
}
```
ben: grant applied, tag will be set by bootstrap flow as `rls_temp=gpu-join-20260323`, TTL automation scheduled in 2h
cheng: watching logs — first node hit decrypt success at 6812345702, node moved to Ready at 6812345715 
alice: canary 1/5 succeeded, starting 4 more joins
marie: confirming audit events showing tagged decrypt entries in keystore logs; no anomalies so far
ben: after final canary completes and warmpool stabilizes, next actions: (1) update warmpool provisioning to emit VPC tag parity, (2) add unit test for sampler policy to include ephemeral aliases, (3) schedule postmortem and rollback playbook review
alice: noted. thanks all, leaving incident open until postmortem scheduled
infra-bot: incident INC-20260323-ml-join-blocker updated: status=mitigated, followup=postmortem-sprint-20260324
